goals.objective: Build more things that make Pico SafeRoom unique and special compared to similar IoT safety dashboards. Scope for this ULW run: add an Incident Command Report feature that turns an alert replay into a shareable response packet with incident metadata, guided checklist status, operator response evidence, related blackbox timeline, and next action. Preserve existing user changes in AGENTS.md and agent-map.md. Use TDD, live HTTP QA, browser QA, cleanup receipts, and final review.
